verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud explicitly markets serverless creation—'Start building instantly without having to size and scale your cluster' (docs-26)—with autoscaling to zero (docs-11, docs-25) and CLI commands to 'Set up ClickHouse Cloud and create cloud-managed ClickHouse clusters' (docs-3, docs-20, docs-31), matching the no-capacity-planning CLI story closely. Missing for 10: explicit API-based (non-CLI) creation walkthrough, independent/hands-on confirmation of 'seconds'-level provisioning time, and third-party verification of the no-capacity-planning claim.
